Location: San Jose, CA
Job Type: Internship
Compensation: Paid internship; compensation to be discussed based on experience and availability.About the Role
We are looking for a Backend Developer Intern to join our engineering team and help build reliable, scalable, and secure backend systems.
In this role, you will work with server-side applications, APIs, databases, and cloud services. You will collaborate with frontend engineers and product team members to support new features, improve existing systems, and gain hands-on experience with production software development.Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain backend services and server-side application logic
- Design, build, and integrate REST APIs
- Work with relational and NoSQL databases
- Write clean, efficient, and maintainable backend code
- Debug, test, and troubleshoot application issues
- Improve system performance, reliability, and scalability
- Support authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations
- Collaborate with frontend developers on application features
- Participate in code reviews and technical discussions
- Assist with deployment, documentation, and ongoing system improvements
- Research and evaluate new backend technologies when neededQualifications

- Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
- Familiarity with Python, Node.js, Java, or another backend programming language
- Basic understanding of server-side development and API design
- Familiarity with SQL or NoSQL databases
- Understanding of Git and version control
- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
- Good communication and teamwork abilities
- Willingness to learn new technologies and development practicesPreferred Qualifications

- Experience with Node.js, Express, FastAPI, Django, Spring Boot, or similar frameworks
- Familiarity with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar databases
- Experience building or integrating REST APIs
- Understanding of authentication, authorization, and application security
- Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, or containerized applications
- Exposure to AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or similar cloud platforms
- Personal projects, GitHub contributions, hackathons, or previous internship experience are a plusWhat We Value
We value strong coding fundamentals, practical problem-solving, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly. Candidates with hands-on backend projects or software development experience are encouraged to apply.
